connector.name: Apple Maps
connector.registryDescription: Search Apple Maps businesses with Apple ratings and aggregated Yelp + TripAdvisor reviews.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.apify.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the johnisanerd account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Apify API token in Bearer format. Get one at https://console.apify.com/account#/integrations?fpr=9n7kx3. Optional if your client supports OAuth.
